analysis.place.algorithm.no_library: Computed on the server: the database has no library for this step.
analysis.place.algorithm.local: Computed on the server: the step needs only the result.
analysis.place.algorithm.not_in_library: Computed on the server: the database’s library has no variant of this step for a part of the graph.
analysis.place.algorithm.enumerating: Computed on the server: listing steps keep their count and length limits there.
analysis.place.algorithm.not_cancellable: Always computed on the server: the database cannot stop a running procedure.
analysis.place.algorithm.option: Computed on the server: the database’s library does not offer a chosen setting.
analysis.place.algorithm.isolated_nodes: Computed on the server: nodes without edges are missing from the database’s projection.
analysis.place.algorithm.empty: Computed on the server: the result has no edges.
analysis.place.algorithm.library_failed: Computed on the server: the database’s library did not answer. The result is the same.
analysis.place.algorithm.place_server: Computed on the server, as set on the step.
analysis.place.algorithm.answer_unreadab: The database answered the step in an unexpected form. Kalzit does not guess a result.
analysis.about.filterFields: Keep only the fields that match.

analysis.about.filterRows: By values: equal, greater, matches, is empty.
analysis.about.stack: Tables with the same fields as one.
analysis.about.seriesToRows: One row per time and series.
analysis.about.reduceSeries: Each series to one value: last, sum and more.
analysis.help.organize: Puts fields in an order, gives them readable names and hides what nobody needs. Changes no values.
analysis.help.filterFields: Keeps or leaves out fields by their name: names you pick, a regular expression, or both. Changes no values.
analysis.help.convert: Turns a field into another type in its place: text into numbers, times or true and false, numbers or times into text. Values that cannot be read become empty.
analysis.help.filterRows: Keeps or leaves out rows by their values. All conditions must hold, or one is enough. An empty value equals nothing.
analysis.help.limit: Keeps only the first or the last rows, such as the ten largest after sorting.
analysis.help.stack: Puts the rows of several queries one under the other. Fields with the same name become one field; a field one table lacks stays empty there.
analysis.help.seriesToRows: Turns series into a long table: one row per time and series with time, metric and value. Handy for tables and for grouping by series.
analysis.help.reduceSeries: Brings every series to one value per calculation, such as the last value or the sum: one row per series, or one row with a field per series.

analysis.filterFields.patternHelp: Found anywhere in the first 150 characters of the name: ^cpu finds names that start with cpu. At most two repeats such as * or + (a leading or trailing .* is free), no repeated group with |, such as (a|b)+.
analysis.filterRows.matchesHelp: A pattern is found anywhere in the first 150 characters of the value. At most two repeats such as * or + (a leading or trailing .* is free), no repeated group with |, such as (a|b)+.
analysis.convert.formatHelp: Without a format, ISO 8601 such as 2026-01-31T08:15. Parts: YYYY, MM, DD, HH, mm, ss, SSS, such as DD.MM.YYYY HH:mm.
